```{r setup, include = FALSE}
## Publication style: theme_clean without its outer border, larger black
## axis text, legends below the panel, no in-plot titles (the section
## headings and figure files carry those).
theme_pub <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_clean(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
          legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(face = "plain"),
          axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = rel(0.9)),
          axis.title = element_text(size = rel(1)),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1)),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", linetype = "dotted"),
          plot.margin = margin(6, 10, 6, 6))
}
theme_set(theme_pub())

source("utils.R")
gc_bucket <- Sys.getenv("GCLOUD_BUCKET")
set_gcloud_bucket(gc_bucket)

## fread that also reads .gz without needing R.utils
fread_any <- function(path, ...) {
  if (grepl("\\.gz$", path)) fread(cmd = paste("gzip -dc", shQuote(path)), ...) else fread(path, ...)
}

## Minimum variants for a subfamily to get its own row in the heatmap
min_subfamily_n <- 20

fig_dir <- Sys.getenv("FIGURES_DIR", "figures")
tab_dir <- Sys.getenv("TABLES_DIR", "tables")
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(tab_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
fig_base <- function(name) file.path(fig_dir, paste0("structure_", name))
save_fig <- function(p, name, w = 7, h = 4) {
  ggsave(paste0(fig_base(name), ".pdf"), p, width = w, height = h)
  ggsave(paste0(fig_base(name), ".png"), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  print(p)
}
save_tab <- function(d, name) fwrite(d, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("structure_", name, ".tsv")), sep = "\t", na = "NA")

wilson_ci <- function(k, n, z = 1.96) {
  p <- ifelse(n > 0, k / n, NA_real_)
  denom <- 1 + z^2 / n
  centre <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / denom
  half <- z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2)) / denom
  list(lo = pmax(0, centre - half), hi = pmin(1, centre + half))
}

## Okabe-Ito, colour-blind safe
FAMILY_COLORS <- c(Alu = "#0072B2", L1 = "#D55E00", SVA = "#009E73", unknown = "#999999")
OUTCOME_LABELS <- c(assigned_fixed = "Fixed source element", assigned_polymorphic = "Polymorphic source element",
                    unique = "Unique locus, no element", multi = "Multi-mapping locus",
                    shared_unmapped = "Shared non-reference source", self_only = "Maps only to insertion site",
                    unmapped = "Unmapped")
OUTCOME_COLORS <- setNames(c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#56B4E9", "#CC79A7", "#E69F00", "#999999", "#D9D9D9"), OUTCOME_LABELS)
SOURCE_TYPE_COLORS <- c("Fixed" = "#0072B2", "Polymorphic" = "#D55E00", "No element identified" = "#999999")
source_type_label <- function(t) factor(fifelse(t %in% "fixed", "Fixed", fifelse(t %in% "polymorphic", "Polymorphic",
                                                                               "No element identified")),
                                        levels = names(SOURCE_TYPE_COLORS))
FLAGS <- c(full_length = "Full-length", five_prime_truncated = "5' truncation",
           three_prime_transduction = "3' transduction", five_prime_inversion = "5' inversion",
           five_prime_transduction = "5' transduction", internal_priming = "Internal priming",
           exon_trapping_candidate = "Exon-trapping", three_prime_truncated = "3' truncation",
           premature_polyadenylation = "Premature pA", internal_deletion = "Internal deletion",
           internal_rearrangement = "Internal rearrangement", orphan_candidate = "Orphan candidate",
           snRNA_chimera = "snRNA chimera", terminal_polyA = "Terminal poly(A)", internal_polyA = "Internal poly(A)")
pct <- scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)
comma <- scales::label_comma()
## Long comma-joined id lists are unbreakable for LaTeX and exhaust pdflatex's memory.
clip_list <- function(x, k = 3) vapply(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x), ",", fixed = TRUE), function(v)
  if (!length(v)) NA_character_ else if (length(v) <= k) paste(v, collapse = ", ")
  else sprintf("%s, ... (%d total)", paste(v[1:k], collapse = ", "), length(v)), "")
fam_scale_fill <- function(...) scale_fill_manual(values = FAMILY_COLORS, ...)
fam_scale_col <- function(...) scale_colour_manual(values = FAMILY_COLORS, ...)
```

# Download catalog outputs

```{r download-catalog}
catalog_dir <- "scratch/alex/pipeline_outputs/mei_structural_catalog"
catalog_prefix <- "mei"
catalog_file <- function(name) glue::glue("{catalog_dir}/{catalog_prefix}.structure_{name}")

per_var <- fread_any(gs_download(catalog_file("per_variant.tsv")), sep = "\t")
per_seq <- fread_any(gs_download(catalog_file("per_sequence.tsv.gz")), sep = "\t")

# Only written when the workflow ran with Reference or TransductionPaf; the
# source-tracing section is skipped without them.
download_optional <- function(path) {
  f <- tryCatch(gs_download(path), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(f) || !file.exists(f)) {
    message("not available, skipping: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  f
}
src_file <- download_optional(catalog_file("transduction_sources.tsv"))
srcsum_file <- download_optional(catalog_file("source_summary.tsv"))
src <- if (!is.null(src_file)) fread_any(src_file, sep = "\t") else NULL
srcsum <- if (!is.null(srcsum_file)) fread_any(srcsum_file, sep = "\t") else NULL
td_file <- download_optional(catalog_file("transductions.tsv"))
tdseg_file <- download_optional(catalog_file("transduction_segments.tsv"))
tdx <- if (!is.null(td_file)) fread_any(td_file, sep = "\t") else NULL
tdseg <- if (!is.null(tdseg_file)) fread_any(tdseg_file, sep = "\t") else NULL
```

# Overview

This report summarises the structural catalog produced by the
`MEIStructuralCatalog` workflow (`scripts/mei_structural_catalog.R`). The
catalog assigns each non-reference Alu, L1 and SVA insertion to the
structural forms of retrotransposition in Hancks & Kazazian 2016
(*Mobile DNA* 7:9), Fig. 2 panels b-i. Every call is made from the
RepeatMasker hits L1ME-AID stores per sequence, after flipping each sequence
into element-sense orientation so that 5' and 3' refer to the element's own
ends.

| Panel | Form | Call |
|---|---|---|
| b | full-length | neither end is missing more than `max_5p/3p_missing` bp of consensus, and there is no 5' inversion |
| c | 5' truncation | consensus start of the 5'-most sense hit, minus 1, is greater than `max_5p_missing` |
| d | 3' transduction | >= `min_transduction` bp of unique sequence between the element's 3' end (or its first poly(A)) and a terminal poly(A) |
| e | 5' inversion | >= `min_inversion` bp of same-family sequence on the opposite strand, 5' of the sense portion (twin priming) |
| f | 5' transduction | unique sequence joined to an intact element 5' end |
| g | internal priming | 3'-truncated element whose last 20 bp are >= 70% A |
| h | exon-trapping | unique 5' sequence joined to an internally starting (5'-truncated) element |
| i | 3' truncation | consensus missing at the 3' end; the subset with a PAS 10-35 nt upstream of an added poly(A) is flagged as premature polyadenylation |

A variant is one insertion (a `var_id` of the clustered allele table), and
its sequences are its **distinct alleles**. The catalog rolls them up to the
modal structure, majority flags and median lengths, weighting each allele by
the haplotypes that carry it, so the rollup describes the form most people
carry. AF and carrier counts come from the genotype table.

```{r weighting, results = "asis"}
cat(sprintf("%d variants, %d with at least one carrier, median %s carriers.\n",
            nrow(per_var), sum(per_var$n_carriers > 0), format(median(per_var$n_carriers))))
```

Every figure is written to `r fig_dir`/ as a vector PDF and a 300 dpi PNG,
and every table to `r tab_dir`/, all prefixed `structure_`.

# Prevalence of structural forms

Share of variants with each structural feature, per family. Error bars are
95% Wilson intervals; prevalence is computed per **variant**, so a common
insertion counts once. Each label carries the number of variants with that
feature: summed over families in the combined plot, and for that family alone
in the per-family plots that follow it.

```{r prevalence, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6}
flags <- intersect(names(FLAGS), names(per_var))
props <- rbindlist(lapply(split(per_var, per_var$family, drop = TRUE), function(d) {
  rbindlist(lapply(flags, function(f) {
    k <- sum(d[[f]]); n <- nrow(d); ci <- wilson_ci(k, n)
    data.table(family = as.character(d$family[1]), feature = f, label = FLAGS[[f]], k = k, n = n, prop = k / n,
               ci_lo = ci$lo, ci_hi = ci$hi)
  }))
}))
save_tab(props, "feature_proportions")
with_n <- function(lab, k) sprintf("%s (n=%s)", lab, comma(k))
## label rows top to bottom in FLAGS order, each carrying its variant count
n_labels <- function(d) {
  k <- d[, .(k = sum(k)), by = label]
  k <- k[match(unname(FLAGS), label)][!is.na(label)]
  factor(with_n(d$label, k$k[match(d$label, k$label)]), levels = rev(with_n(k$label, k$k)))
}
props[, label_n := n_labels(props)]
props[, label := factor(label, levels = rev(unname(FLAGS)))]
props[, family := factor(family, levels = rev(fams))]
prev_grid <- theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
                   panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey85", linetype = "dotted"))
p <- ggplot(props, aes(prop, label_n, fill = family)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi), position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.35,
                linewidth = 0.35, orientation = "y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = pct, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))) +
  fam_scale_fill(breaks = fams) +
  labs(x = "Variants with feature", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  prev_grid
save_fig(p, "feature_proportions", 7, 6)

for (fm in fams) {
  d <- props[family == fm]
  d[, label_n := n_labels(d)]
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(prop, label_n)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = FAMILY_COLORS[[fm]]) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi), width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.35, orientation = "y") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = pct, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))) +
    labs(x = sprintf("%s variants with feature (of %s)", fm, comma(d$n[1])), y = NULL) +
    prev_grid
  save_fig(p, paste0("feature_proportions_", fm), 6, 5)
}
props[, family := factor(family, levels = fams)]
knitr::kable(dcast(props, label ~ family, value.var = "prop", fun.aggregate = function(x) round(100 * x, 1))[order(-label)],
             caption = "Percent of variants with each feature")
```

# Truncation

Cumulative distribution of the fraction of the consensus each insertion
retains (5' truncation profile), the number of consensus bases missing at the
5' end, and insertion length.

```{r truncation-cdf, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4}
tr <- per_var[!is.na(retained_cons_frac)]
if (nrow(tr)) {
  p <- ggplot(tr, aes(retained_cons_frac, colour = family)) + stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = pct) + scale_y_continuous(labels = pct) + fam_scale_col() +
    labs(x = "Consensus retained", y = "Cumulative share of insertions", colour = NULL)
  save_fig(p, "five_prime_truncation_cdf", 5, 4)
}
```

```{r truncation-hist, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3.2}

  p <- ggplot(per_var[!is.na(five_prime_missing)], aes(five_prime_missing, fill = family)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    facet_wrap(~family, nrow = 1, scales = "free") + fam_scale_fill(guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = "Consensus bp missing at the 5' end", y = "Insertions")
  save_fig(p, "five_prime_missing_hist", 7, 3.2)
}
p <- ggplot(per_var, aes(L, fill = family)) + geom_histogram(bins = 50, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma) + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  facet_wrap(~family, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") + fam_scale_fill(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Insertion length (bp)", y = "Insertions")
save_fig(p, "insertion_length_hist", 7, 3.2)
mech <- per_var[three_prime_truncated == TRUE, .N, by = .(family,
  mechanism = fifelse(internal_priming, "internal priming (g)",
              fifelse(premature_polyadenylation, "premature pA (i)", "unclassified")))]
if (nrow(mech)) knitr::kable(mech, caption = "Mechanism of 3' truncations")
```

# 5' inversions and poly(A) tails

Length of the inverted 5' segment against the rest of the insertion for
twin-priming events, and terminal poly(A) length.

```{r inversions, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4}
inv <- per_var[five_prime_inversion == TRUE]
if (nrow(inv)) {
  p <- ggplot(inv, aes(inversion_len, L - inversion_len, colour = family)) + geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) + fam_scale_col() +
    labs(x = "Inverted 5' segment (bp)", y = "Sense segment + tail (bp)", colour = NULL)
  save_fig(p, "five_prime_inversions", 5, 4)
  if (has_seq) {
    jn <- per_seq[five_prime_inversion == TRUE & !is.na(inversion_junction),
                  .(median_junction = as.numeric(median(inversion_junction)), frac_deletion = mean(inversion_junction > 0),
                    frac_duplication = mean(inversion_junction < 0)), by = family]
    print(knitr::kable(jn, caption = "Inversion junction: >0 = deletion, <0 = duplication between inverted and sense segments"))
  }
}
```

```{r polya, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3.2}
if (any(per_var$terminal_polyA)) {

    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = "Terminal poly(A) length (bp)", y = "Insertions")
  save_fig(p, "polyA_length_hist", 7, 3.2)
}
```

# Transductions

Length of transduced sequence, by family and by end.

```{r transductions, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
td <- rbind(per_var[three_prime_transduction == TRUE | orphan_candidate == TRUE, .(family, kind = "3' transduction", len = tdx3_len)],
            per_var[five_prime_transduction == TRUE | exon_trapping_candidate == TRUE, .(family, kind = "5' transduction", len = tdx5_len)])
if (nrow(td)) {
  p <- ggplot(td[!is.na(len)], aes(len, fill = family)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = comma) + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    facet_grid(kind ~ family, scales = "free_y") + fam_scale_fill(guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "Transduced sequence (bp)", y = "Insertions")
  save_fig(p, "transduction_length", 7, 4.5)
  knitr::kable(td[, .(n = .N, median_bp = as.numeric(median(len, na.rm = TRUE))), by = .(family, kind)],
               caption = "Transductions per family")
} else {
  cat("No transductions were called.\n")
}
```

# Subfamilies and allele frequency

Share of variants with each feature, per subfamily with at least
`r min_subfamily_n` variants.

```{r subfamily, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 7}
min_n <- min_subfamily_n
heat_f <- intersect(c("full_length", "five_prime_truncated", "three_prime_truncated", "five_prime_inversion",
                      "three_prime_transduction", "five_prime_transduction", "internal_priming", "exon_trapping_candidate"),
                    names(per_var))
sf <- per_var[, c(list(n = .N), lapply(.SD, mean)), by = .(family, subfamily), .SDcols = heat_f][n >= min_n]
if (nrow(sf)) {
  save_tab(sf, "subfamily_features")
  hm <- melt(sf, id.vars = c("subfamily", "n", "family"), variable.name = "feature", value.name = "frac")
  hm[, feature := factor(FLAGS[as.character(feature)], levels = unname(FLAGS[heat_f]))]
  hm[, ylab := sprintf("%s (n = %s)", subfamily, comma(n))]
  hm[, ylab := factor(ylab, levels = rev(unique(ylab[order(family, subfamily)])))]
  h <- max(3, 0.24 * nrow(sf) + 2)
  p <- ggplot(hm, aes(feature, ylab, fill = frac)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(100 * frac), colour = frac > 0.6), size = 2.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "black")) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#08306B", limits = c(0, 1), labels = pct) +
    facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Variants with feature") +
    theme(axis.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 0, vjust = 0), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"))
  save_fig(p, "subfamily_heatmap", 7.5, h)
} else {
  cat(sprintf("No subfamily has >= %d variants (min_subfamily_n).\n", min_n))
}
```

Allele frequency of variants carrying each structural feature.

```{r af, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 4}
has_af <- "af" %in% names(per_var) && any(!is.na(per_var$af) & per_var$af > 0)
if (has_af) {
  af_long <- melt(per_var[!is.na(af) & af > 0], id.vars = c("variant_id", "family", "af"),
                  measure.vars = c("full_length", "five_prime_truncated", "five_prime_inversion",
                                   "three_prime_transduction", "five_prime_transduction"))[value == TRUE]
  af_long[, feature := factor(FLAGS[as.character(variable)], levels = unname(FLAGS))]
  p <- ggplot(af_long, aes(feature, af, fill = family)) +

    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(drop0trailing = TRUE)) +
    facet_wrap(~family, nrow = 1) + fam_scale_fill(guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Allele frequency") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1))
  save_fig(p, "af_by_structure", 7.5, 4)
} else {
  cat("No variant has a non-zero allele frequency, so the AF analyses are skipped.\n")
}
```

# Agreement with INTACT_MEI

INTACT_MEI flags a sequence `INTACT` when both element ends are within 50 bp
of the consensus and `INTACT_3end` when only the 3' end is. The catalog makes
its own full-length call with the same 50 bp threshold (L1/SVA; 20 bp for
Alu) but from independently parsed hits, so the two should agree closely; a
large disagreement points at a parsing or orientation problem rather than
biology.

```{r intact}
if (has_seq && "intact_flag" %in% names(per_seq) && any(!is.na(per_seq$intact_flag))) {
  ic <- per_seq[, .(n = .N), by = .(family, intact_flag = fifelse(is.na(intact_flag), "(not flagged)", intact_flag),
                                    catalog = fifelse(full_length, "full_length",
                                              fifelse(five_prime_truncated, "5' truncated", "other")))]
  save_tab(ic, "intact_agreement")
  knitr::kable(dcast(ic, family + intact_flag ~ catalog, value.var = "n", fill = 0),
               caption = "INTACT_MEI flag (rows) vs catalog call (columns), per sequence")
} else {
  cat("No INTACT_MEI flags in the per-sequence table.\n")
}
```

# Call concordance within variants

`structure_concordance` is the share of the variant's sequences with its
modal structure, weighted by carried haplotypes;
`allele_concordance` is the same share counting each distinct allele once. A
variant whose carriers mostly agree but whose alleles do not has rare
divergent alleles, which are more likely allele-calling or assembly errors
than real structural polymorphism.

```{r concordance, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3.2}
m <- per_var[n_sequences > 1]
if (nrow(m)) {
  cat(sprintf("%d variants have more than one sequence: mean concordance %.3f, fully concordant %.1f%%.\n",
              nrow(m), mean(m$structure_concordance), 100 * mean(m$structure_concordance == 1)))
  p <- ggplot(m, aes(structure_concordance, fill = family)) + geom_histogram(bins = 20, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    facet_wrap(~family, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") + fam_scale_fill(guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = pct) + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = "Carried haplotypes with the modal structure", y = "Variants")
  save_fig(p, "concordance_hist", 7, 3.2)
  low <- m[structure_concordance < 0.5][order(structure_concordance)]
  if (nrow(low)) {
    save_tab(low, "low_concordance_variants")
    cols <- intersect(c("variant_id", "family", "subfamily", "n_sequences", "n_carriers", "structure",
                        "structure_concordance", "allele_concordance"), names(low))
    knitr::kable(head(low[, ..cols], 15), caption = "Least concordant variants (candidates for allele or annotation errors)")
  }
} else {
  cat("Every variant has a single sequence, so there is no within-variant concordance to report.\n")
}
```

# Statistical tests

The tests are:

- chi-square tests of each feature across families
- within each family (when AF is available), Mann-Whitney tests of AF with vs
  without each feature
- Spearman correlations of AF with the retained consensus fraction, poly(A)
  length and divergence

All p-values are Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted together.

```{r tests}
tests <- list()
for (f in flags) {
  if (length(fams) < 2) break
  tab <- table(factor(per_var$family, levels = fams), factor(per_var[[f]], levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))
  if (all(colSums(tab) > 0)) {
    ct <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab))
    tests[[length(tests) + 1]] <- data.table(test = "chi2_across_families", family = "all", feature = f,
                                             statistic = unname(ct$statistic), p = ct$p.value)
  }
}
if (has_af) for (fm in fams) {
  d <- per_var[family == fm & !is.na(af)]
  for (f in flags) {
    a <- d[get(f) == TRUE, af]; b <- d[get(f) == FALSE, af]
    if (length(a) >= 5 && length(b) >= 5) {
      wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b))
      tests[[length(tests) + 1]] <- data.table(test = "AF_wilcoxon_with_vs_without", family = fm, feature = f,
        statistic = unname(wt$statistic), p = wt$p.value, median_with = median(a), median_without = median(b),
        n_with = length(a), n_without = length(b))
    }
  }
  for (col in c("retained_cons_frac", "polyA_len", "divergence")) {
    x <- d[!is.na(get(col))]
    if (nrow(x) >= 10 && uniqueN(x[[col]]) > 1 && uniqueN(x$af) > 1) {
      ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[[col]], x$af, method = "spearman"))
      tests[[length(tests) + 1]] <- data.table(test = paste0("spearman_AF_vs_", col), family = fm, feature = col,
                                               statistic = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n_with = nrow(x))
    }
  }
}
tests <- rbindlist(tests, fill = TRUE)
if (nrow(tests)) {
  tests[, q_bh := p.adjust(p, "BH")]
  save_tab(tests, "feature_tests")
  knitr::kable(tests[order(q_bh)][1:min(.N, 20), .(test, family, feature, statistic, p, q_bh)], digits = 4,
               caption = "Top tests (BH-adjusted)")
} else {
  cat("No test had enough data (needs >= 2 families, or allele frequencies).\n")
}
```

```{r sources-header, eval = has_src, results = "asis"}
cat("# Transduction sources\n\n")
cat("Transduced segments were mapped to the reference with minimap2.",
    "Hits within `self_window` of the insertion's own site were removed;",
    "they indicate flanking-sequence capture, not transduction.",
    "Each remaining hit was assigned to a same-family, same-strand element in the",
    "expected position: **upstream** for 3' transductions and **downstream** for 5'.",
    "Candidate elements are the reference RepeatMasker track (**fixed** sources),",
    "any `known_sources` BEDs, and every insertion in this cohort (**polymorphic**",
    "sources). A polymorphic source is absent from the reference, but the flank it",
    "transduces is ordinary reference sequence beside its insertion point, so its",
    "segments map there with no reference element present; such a locus is",
    "assigned to the cohort insertion sitting at it in the right orientation.",
    "Recurrent segments that are unmapped or map only to the insertion site were",
    "clustered all-vs-all into non-reference clusters, and each unplaced segment",
    "was also searched against every other cohort insertion's sequence.\n\n")
```

## Concatenated transductions

A source element can itself carry a transduction, so its offspring carry
sequence from more than one source locus (Kirby et al. 2025, Mobile DNA
16:42). Each transduced segment was split into sub-segments that tile it,
numbered from the element outward: the innermost is the oldest inherited
piece, the outermost the immediate source's flank. A sub-segment is traced
when it maps uniquely or sits beside a source element; an inherited piece
nested at the inner end of an alignment to a different locus (the immediate
source still carries it) is split off. Flags: concatenated (two or more
source loci), single source (one locus, fully traced), single source partial
(one locus plus untraced stretches), insertion site only, untraced. For 3'
events, a poly(A) at the outer end of an inner sub-segment is the immediate
source's own tail and supports the concatenation. Stretches too short or too
repetitive to place genome-wide were searched again against the repeat-masked
2 kb flanks of candidate source elements only (n_flank_placed).

```{r concatenated, eval = has_tdx, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3.5}
## Sub-segments outermost first, grouped into generations: consecutive
## sub-segments from one source locus (or one untraced run) are one generation,
## 1 = the immediate source, 2 = the first grandparent; poly(A) linkers and
## insertion-site captures belong to none.
seg_generations <- function(tdseg) {
  g <- tdseg[!status %in% c("polyA", "insertion_site")][order(variant_id, kind, -segment)]
  g[, key := fifelse(status == "traced", fifelse(is.na(source_locus), paste(chrom, t_start), source_locus), "untraced")]
  g[, generation := cumsum(c(TRUE, key[-1] != key[-.N])), by = .(variant_id, kind)]
  g[, key := NULL]
}
GEN_LEVELS <- c("Immediate source", "Grandparent", "Older ancestor", "Untraced", "Poly(A)", "Insertion site")
GEN_COLORS <- setNames(c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", "#009E73", "#BBBBBB", "#F0E442", "#666666"), GEN_LEVELS)
gen <- seg_generations(tdseg)
segs_cls <- merge(tdseg, gen[, .(variant_id, kind, segment, generation)], by = c("variant_id", "kind", "segment"), all.x = TRUE)
segs_cls[, cls := fcase(status == "polyA", "Poly(A)", status == "insertion_site", "Insertion site",
                        status != "traced", "Untraced", generation == 1L, "Immediate source",
                        generation == 2L, "Grandparent", default = "Older ancestor")]
segs_cls[, cls := factor(cls, levels = GEN_LEVELS)]

FLAG_LEVELS <- c(concatenated = "Concatenated (>= 2 source loci)", single_source = "Single source",
                 single_source_partial = "Single source, partly untraced",
                 insertion_site_only = "Insertion site only", untraced = "Untraced")
FLAG_COLORS <- setNames(c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", "#56B4E9", "#E69F00", "#D9D9D9"), FLAG_LEVELS)
tdx[, kind_label := fifelse(kind == "5p", "5' transduction", "3' transduction")]
fc <- tdx[, .N, by = .(family, kind_label, flag)][, frac := N / sum(N), by = .(family, kind_label)]
fc[, flag_label := factor(FLAG_LEVELS[flag], levels = FLAG_LEVELS)]
fc[, group := factor(paste(family, kind_label, sep = ", "), levels = rev(sort(unique(paste(family, kind_label, sep = ", ")))))]
p <- ggplot(fc, aes(frac, group, fill = flag_label)) + geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = pct, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = FLAG_COLORS, drop = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Transduced segments", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
save_fig(p, "transduction_concatenation", 7, 0.45 * uniqueN(fc$group) + 2.3)
print(knitr::kable(dcast(tdx, family + kind ~ flag, value.var = "variant_id", fun.aggregate = length),
                   caption = "Transduced segments by sub-segment tracing flag"))
if (!"n_flank_placed" %in% names(tdx)) tdx[, n_flank_placed := NA_integer_]
cc <- tdx[flag == "concatenated", .(variant_id, family, kind, td_len, n_segments, n_source_loci,
                                     segment_sources, n_flank_placed, has_inherited_nested, outer_polyA_breaks)]
save_tab(cc, "concatenated_transductions")
if (nrow(cc)) {
  shown <- head(cc[order(-n_source_loci, -td_len)], 25)
  shown[, segment_sources := stri_replace_all_fixed(segment_sources, ";", "; ")]
  print(knitr::kable(shown, caption = sprintf(paste(
    "Concatenated transductions (%d of %d shown; all in structure_concatenated_transductions.tsv).",
    "segment_sources lists the sub-segments innermost (oldest) first."), nrow(shown), nrow(cc))))
}
```

Length of each transduction against the lengths of the sub-segments it is
built from. Sub-segments are coloured by the generation of their source,
counted from the outside in: the immediate source's flank, the first
grandparent's, older ancestors', and stretches with no traced source.
Poly(A) linkers and insertion-site captures are left out of the sub-segment
panel.

```{r transduction-lengths, eval = has_tdx, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
lens <- rbind(
  tdx[, .(kind_label, panel = "Whole transduction", cls = "Whole transduction", len = td_len)],
  segs_cls[!cls %in% c("Poly(A)", "Insertion site"),
           .(kind_label = fifelse(kind == "5p", "5' transduction", "3' transduction"), panel = "Sub-segments",
             cls = as.character(cls), len = seg_len)])
lens[, panel := factor(panel, levels = c("Whole transduction", "Sub-segments"))]

p <- ggplot(lens[len > 0], aes(len, fill = cls)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma) + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Whole transduction" = "grey35", GEN_COLORS), drop = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ kind_label, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Length (bp)", y = "Count", fill = NULL)
save_fig(p, "transduction_segment_lengths", 7, 5)
print(knitr::kable(lens[, .(n = .N, median_bp = as.numeric(median(len)), mean_bp = round(mean(len))), by = .(kind_label, panel, cls)][

```

Architecture of the concatenated transductions: one bar per transduction,
drawn outward from the element (0 bp = the element's end), its length the
total transduced length, each block a sub-segment labelled with its length
and coloured by the generation of its source. At most `arch_max` are drawn,
those with the most source loci and then the longest.

```{r transduction-architecture, eval = has_tdx && any(tdx$flag == "concatenated"), fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6}

a[, `:=`(x0 = fifelse(kind == "3p", seg_start - 1, td_len - seg_end), x1 = fifelse(kind == "3p", seg_end, td_len - seg_start + 1))]
a[, row := factor(paste0(variant_id, " (", fifelse(kind == "5p", "5'", "3'"), ")"),
                  levels = rev(unique(ids[, paste0(variant_id, " (", fifelse(kind == "5p", "5'", "3'"), ")")])))]
tot <- unique(a[, .(row, td_len)])
p <- ggplot(a) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = as.integer(row) - 0.38, ymax = as.integer(row) + 0.38, fill = cls),
            colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = a[seg_len >= 0.06 * max(td_len)], aes(x = (x0 + x1) / 2, y = as.integer(row), label = seg_len,
                                                        colour = cls %in% c("Poly(A)", "Untraced")), size = 2.1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "white"), guide = "none") +
  geom_text(data = tot, aes(x = td_len, y = as.integer(row), label = paste(comma(td_len), "bp")), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(a$row)), labels = levels(a$row), expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = GEN_COLORS, drop = TRUE) +

save_fig(p, "transduction_architecture", 7, 0.2 * nrow(ids) + 1.6)
```

```{r circos-header, eval = has_src || has_tdx, results = "asis"}
cat("## Genomic view of transduction sources\n\n")
cat("One circos plot per family. The outer ring is the hg38 karyotype. Each",
    "lollipop is a source element, placed at its locus, its height the number of",
    "offspring insertions carrying its transduced sequence, coloured by whether",
    "the source is fixed (in the reference) or polymorphic (a cohort insertion).",
    "Only immediate sources are drawn: each transduction counts once, for the",
    "source of its outermost sub-segment, the element it was copied from",
    "directly. The inner sub-segments of a concatenated transduction, sequence",
    "inherited from older (grandparent) sources, are not drawn, and a",
    "transduction whose outermost sub-segment is untraced is counted as",
    "unplaced rather than credited to an inner source.",
    "The most prolific sources are labelled with element, position and offspring",
    "count. Outermost sub-segments with no source element, and unplaced ones,",
    "are not drawn; the centre gives their counts.\n\n")
cat("A second plot per family (transduction_circos_grandparent) draws the first",
    "grandparents instead: the source of the next generation inward, i.e. the",
    "element the immediate source itself inherited its transduction from.",
    "Consecutive sub-segments from one source locus count as one generation,",
    "and poly(A) linkers and insertion-site captures as none. Only",
    "transductions with an inner generation enter it; one whose inner generation",
    "is untraced or has no source element is counted in the centre, not",
    "drawn.\n\n")
```

```{r circos, eval = has_src || has_tdx, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 6.5}
HG38 <- data.frame(
  chr = paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y")), start = 0,
  end = c(248956422, 242193529, 198295559, 190214555, 181538259, 170805979, 159345973, 145138636,
          138394717, 133797422, 135086622, 133275309, 114364328, 107043718, 101991189, 90338345,
          83257441, 80373285, 58617616, 64444167, 46709983, 50818468, 156040895, 57227415))
norm_chr <- function(x) fifelse(startsWith(x, "chr"), x, paste0("chr", x))
circos_n_labels <- 6
SRC_TYPES <- c("Fixed", "Polymorphic")

draw_circos <- function(fam, sources, n_td, n_unplaced, what = "traced transductions") {
  op <- par(mar = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
  on.exit({ circos.clear(); par(op) })
  circos.par(start.degree = 90, gap.degree = c(rep(1.2, nrow(HG38) - 1), 6),
             cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0), track.margin = c(0.004, 0.004), points.overflow.warning = FALSE,
             canvas.xlim = c(-1.05, 1.05), canvas.ylim = c(-1.5, 1.05))
  circos.genomicInitialize(HG38, plotType = NULL)
  circos.track(ylim = c(0, 1), track.height = 0.045, bg.border = NA, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    circos.rect(CELL_META$xlim[1], 0, CELL_META$xlim[2], 1, col = "grey85", border = "grey45", lwd = 0.4)
    circos.text(CELL_META$xcenter, CELL_META$ylim[2] + mm_y(3.2), sub("^chr", "", CELL_META$sector.index),
                cex = 0.75, facing = "inside", niceFacing = TRUE)
  })
  top <- head(sources[order(-n)], circos_n_labels)[, rank := .I]
  ymax <- max(sources$n) * 1.2
  circos.track(ylim = c(0, ymax), track.height = 0.24, bg.border = NA, bg.col = "grey97", panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    for (v in pretty(c(0, ymax), 3)[-1]) if (v < ymax) circos.lines(CELL_META$xlim, c(v, v), col = "white", lwd = 0.8)
    s <- sources[chr == CELL_META$sector.index][order(n)]
    if (!nrow(s)) return()
    col <- SOURCE_TYPE_COLORS[as.character(s$type)]
    circos.segments(s$pos, 0, s$pos, s$n, col = col, lwd = 1)
    circos.points(s$pos, s$n, pch = 21, col = "white", bg = col, cex = 1.1)
    tp <- top[chr == CELL_META$sector.index]
    if (nrow(tp)) circos.text(tp$pos, tp$n + ymax * 0.12, tp$rank, cex = 0.6, font = 2, facing = "downward")
  })
  circos.yaxis(side = "left", at = pretty(c(0, ymax), 3), sector.index = HG38$chr[1], labels.cex = 0.5,
               tick.length = convert_x(0.6, "mm", HG38$chr[1]))
  n_by <- function(ty) sum(sources$type == ty)
  text(0, 0.07, fam, cex = 1.6, font = 2)
  text(0, -0.1, sprintf("%s fixed and %s polymorphic sources\nof %s %s\n(%s with no source element not drawn)",
                        comma(n_by("Fixed")), comma(n_by("Polymorphic")), comma(n_td), what, comma(n_unplaced)), cex = 0.62)
  if (nrow(top)) {
    half <- ceiling(nrow(top) / 2)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(top))) {
      text(if (i <= half) -0.98 else 0.06, -1.27 - 0.075 * ((i - 1) %% half), adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = 0.62,
           col = SOURCE_TYPE_COLORS[[as.character(top$type[i])]], sprintf("%d  %s", i, top$label[i]))
    }
  }
  legend(0, -1.12, xjust = 0.5, yjust = 0.5, horiz = TRUE, bty = "n", cex = 0.8, pch = 21, pt.cex = 1.4,
         col = "white", pt.bg = SOURCE_TYPE_COLORS[SRC_TYPES],
         legend = c("Fixed source element", "Polymorphic source element"))
}

## generation g of every transduction that has one; outputs without the
## segments table only have whole-segment tracing, i.e. generation 1
gen_sources <- function(g) {
  if (!has_tdx) {
    return(src[, .(variant_id, family, source_element, source_type, source_locus, source_chrom, source_start)])
  }
  o <- seg_generations(tdseg)[generation == g][, .SD[1], by = .(variant_id, kind)]
  o[status != "traced", `:=`(source_element = NA_character_, source_type = NA_character_, source_locus = NA_character_)]
  o[, .(variant_id, family, source_element, source_type, source_locus,
        source_chrom = fifelse(is.na(source_element), NA_character_, chrom),
        source_start = as.numeric(stri_match_first_regex(source_locus, ":(\\d+)-")[, 2]))]
}

circos_set <- function(tab, file_prefix, what) {
  for (fam in fams) {
    s <- tab[family == fam]
    s[, type := source_type_label(source_type)]
    sources <- s[type %in% SRC_TYPES & !is.na(source_chrom) & !is.na(source_start),
                 .(chr = norm_chr(source_chrom[1]), pos = as.numeric(source_start[1]), n = uniqueN(variant_id),
                   type = type[1], element = source_element[1]), by = source_locus]
    off <- sources[!chr %in% HG38$chr, .N]
    sources <- sources[chr %in% HG38$chr]
    if (!nrow(sources)) {
      cat(sprintf("%s: no %s source element on chr1-22/X/Y, so no %s plot.\n\n", fam, what, file_prefix))
      next
    }
    if (off) cat(sprintf("%s: %d source loci off chr1-22/X/Y not drawn.\n\n", fam, off))
    sources[, label := trimws(sprintf("%s %s:%.1f Mb (n=%d)", fifelse(is.na(element), "", element), sub("^chr", "", chr), pos / 1e6, n))]
    n_td <- uniqueN(s$variant_id)
    n_unplaced <- uniqueN(s[!type %in% SRC_TYPES, variant_id])
    base <- fig_base(paste0(file_prefix, "_", fam))
    cur <- dev.cur()
    pdf(paste0(base, ".pdf"), width = 6.5, height = 6.5); draw_circos(fam, sources, n_td, n_unplaced, what); dev.off()
    png(paste0(base, ".png"), width = 6.5, height = 6.5, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")
    draw_circos(fam, sources, n_td, n_unplaced, what); dev.off()
    dev.set(cur)
    draw_circos(fam, sources, n_td, n_unplaced, what)
  }
}

circos_set(gen_sources(1L), "transduction_circos", "traced transductions")
if (has_tdx) {
  circos_set(gen_sources(2L), "transduction_circos_grandparent", "transductions with an inner generation")
} else {
  cat("No transduction_segments table, so no grandparent plot.\n\n")
}
```

# Numbers for the text

One row per number quoted in the main text, for the family in `text_family`.
Truncation lengths are consensus bases missing, over truncated insertions
only; transduction lengths are over insertions carrying that transduction.
Source counts are distinct source loci, given for every assigned segment and
for uniquely mapped segments only (MAPQ >= `min_mapq`), because a
multi-mapping segment's source can be the wrong copy. The genome-wide count
of fixed full-length elements needs the RepeatMasker track the workflow used
(`ref_rmsk`): RepeatMasker fragments sharing an element id are joined, and an
element is full-length when at most `full_length_max_missing` consensus bases
are missing at either end (the catalog's own default for SVA).

```{r key-numbers-params}
text_family <- "SVA"
## TODO: the UCSC rmsk.txt(.gz) given to the workflow as RefRmsk; "" skips the genome-wide full-length count
ref_rmsk <- ""
full_length_max_missing <- 50
```

```{r key-numbers}
fv <- per_var[family == text_family]
summ_bp <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return("none")
  sprintf("mean %s bp (median %s, n = %s)", comma(round(mean(x))), comma(round(median(x))), comma(length(x)))
}
share <- function(k, n) sprintf("%s of %s (%.1f%%)", comma(k), comma(n), 100 * k / n)
key <- list(
  list("5' truncation, consensus bp missing", summ_bp(fv[five_prime_truncated == TRUE, five_prime_missing]), ""),
  list("3' truncation, consensus bp missing", summ_bp(fv[three_prime_truncated == TRUE, three_prime_missing]), ""),
  list("5' transduction length", summ_bp(fv[five_prime_transduction == TRUE | exon_trapping_candidate == TRUE, tdx5_len]), ""),
  list("3' transduction length", summ_bp(fv[three_prime_transduction == TRUE | orphan_candidate == TRUE, tdx3_len]), ""),
  list("Either transduction length", summ_bp(c(fv[five_prime_transduction == TRUE | exon_trapping_candidate == TRUE, tdx5_len],
                                               fv[three_prime_transduction == TRUE | orphan_candidate == TRUE, tdx3_len])), ""),
  list("Full-length variants", share(sum(fv$full_length), nrow(fv)), ""))
if (has_src) {
  s <- src[family == text_family]
  n_td <- fv[three_prime_transduction | orphan_candidate | five_prime_transduction | exon_trapping_candidate, .N]
  n_var <- function(d) uniqueN(d$variant_id)
  loci <- function(d) uniqueN(d[!is.na(source_locus), source_locus])
  u <- s[mapping == "unique"]
  key <- c(key, list(
    list("Variants with a transduction", comma(n_td), ""),
    list("Variants whose transduced segments were traced", comma(n_var(s)), ""),
    list("Traced variants mapped to a reference locus", comma(n_var(s[mapping %in% c("unique", "multi")])), comma(n_var(u))),
    list("Traced variants assigned a source element", comma(n_var(s[!is.na(source_type)])), comma(n_var(u[!is.na(source_type)]))),
    list("Distinct fixed source elements", comma(loci(s[source_type %in% "fixed"])), comma(loci(u[source_type %in% "fixed"]))),
    list("Distinct polymorphic source sites", comma(loci(s[source_type %in% "polymorphic"])),
         comma(loci(u[source_type %in% "polymorphic"])))))
  rm_file <- if (nzchar(ref_rmsk)) download_optional(ref_rmsk) else NULL
  if (!is.null(rm_file)) {
    rm <- fread_any(rm_file, header = FALSE, sep = "\t")
    if (ncol(rm) < 17) stop("ref_rmsk is not a UCSC rmsk.txt table (17 columns): ", ref_rmsk)
    rm <- rm[stri_detect_regex(V11, paste0("^", text_family))]
    ## UCSC rmsk: on "-" the consensus start sits in repLeft and repStart holds -(bases left)
    rm[, `:=`(miss5 = fifelse(V10 == "+", V14, V16) - 1L, miss3 = abs(fifelse(V10 == "+", V16, V14)))]
    el <- rm[, .(start = min(V7), end = max(V8), miss5 = min(miss5), miss3 = min(miss3)), by = .(chrom = V6, id = V17)]
    el[, chrom := fifelse(startsWith(chrom, "chr"), chrom, paste0("chr", chrom))]
    fl <- el[miss5 <= full_length_max_missing & miss3 <= full_length_max_missing]
    fl_sources <- function(d) {
      d <- unique(d[source_type %in% "fixed" & !is.na(source_start),
                    .(chrom = fifelse(startsWith(source_chrom, "chr"), source_chrom, paste0("chr", source_chrom)),
                      source_start, source_end)])
      if (!nrow(d)) return(0L)
      uniqueN(fl[d, on = .(chrom, start <= source_end, end >= source_start), nomatch = 0, .(chrom, x.start, x.end)])
    }
    key <- c(key, list(
      list(sprintf("Fixed full-length %s elements in the reference", text_family), comma(nrow(fl)), ""),
      list("Fixed full-length elements that are traced sources", share(fl_sources(s), nrow(fl)),
           share(fl_sources(u), nrow(fl)))))
  } else {
    cat("ref_rmsk not set: the share of the reference's full-length elements that act as sources is not computed.\n")
  }
}
key <- rbindlist(lapply(key, function(r) data.table(quantity = r[[1]], all = r[[2]], uniquely_mapped = r[[3]])))
save_tab(key, paste0("key_numbers_", text_family))
knitr::kable(key, col.names = c("Quantity", "All", "Uniquely mapped only"),
             caption = sprintf("%s numbers quoted in the text", text_family))
```
